item.title: Infini-AI-Lab Releases Hermit, an Open-Source Harness Adapter Framework for AI Agents
item.description:
Infini-AI-Lab released Hermit, an Apache-2.0 harness adapter framework that trains an external layer of instructions, skills, memory and tools from task feedback, leaving the agent’s model and harness unchanged.

The post Infini-AI-Lab Releases Hermit, an Open-Source Harness Adapter Framework for AI Agents appeared first on MarkTechPost.

item.title: Block Unveils Dessa, a Full-Duplex Speech Model Trained Only on Speech
item.description:
Block’s AI lab released Dessa, a full-duplex speech-to-speech model trained only on human conversation audio. It runs locally on a MacBook Pro M4 Max, but Block has published no size, benchmarks or weights.

The post Block Unveils Dessa, a Full-Duplex Speech Model Trained Only on Speech appeared first on MarkTechPost.

item.title: AssemblyAI Ships AssemblyAI-TTS-1: A $15 per 1M Character Text-to-Speech API for Voice Agents
item.description:
AssemblyAI has released AssemblyAI-TTS-1, its first text-to-speech model for voice agents. It costs $15 per 1M characters, offers unlimited concurrency without a contract, and supports 6 languages at launch.

The post AssemblyAI Ships AssemblyAI-TTS-1: A $15 per 1M Character Text-to-Speech API for Voice Agents appeared first on MarkTechPost.

item.title: NVIDIA Releases Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe: An Open 30B MoE Model for 40-Language Transcription with ~4B Active Parameters
item.description:
NVIDIA released Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe, an open-weights speech LLM with 4.3B active parameters. It transcribes 40 languages, adds speaker labels and word timestamps, and posts a 4.71% mean WER on the English Open ASR Leaderboard.

The post NVIDIA Releases Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe: An Open 30B MoE Model for 40-Language Transcription with ~4B Active Parameters appeared first on MarkTechPost.

item.title: Google DeepMind Introduces Gemini 4 Carbon, Its Top Model for Cyber Defense and Coding
item.description:
Google DeepMind introduced Gemini 4 Carbon, a frontier model that scores 59 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index and 88.2% on SEC-bench Pro. Access starts with vetted cyber defenders, at $2/$10 per million tokens.

The post Google DeepMind Introduces Gemini 4 Carbon, Its Top Model for Cyber Defense and Coding appeared first on MarkTechPost.

item.title: MiniMax Open-Sources MCode Stack: 15 Agent Skills Its Coding Team Uses Daily
item.description:
MiniMax has open-sourced MCode Stack, an MIT-licensed repo of 17 SKILL.md skills and 5 checklists that its MiniMax Code team uses daily for code review, subagent splits, context budgets and long-running commands.

The post MiniMax Open-Sources MCode Stack: 15 Agent Skills Its Coding Team Uses Daily appeared first on MarkTechPost.

item.title: Polymathic AI and Princeton Researchers Release FlashMap, a Flow Map Drafter for 6.14x Faster LLM Decoding
item.description:
FlashMap is a speculative decoding drafter from Polymathic AI, Princeton and USC ISI researchers. It drafts 16 tokens jointly in one pass and reaches up to 6.14x lossless speedup on Qwen3-8B.

The post Polymathic AI and Princeton Researchers Release FlashMap, a Flow Map Drafter for 6.14x Faster LLM Decoding appeared first on MarkTechPost.

item.title: Meet Google DeepMind’s Genie 4: Real-Time World Model With Native Audio
item.description:
Google DeepMind released Genie 4 as a research preview. The real-time world model adds native audio, live dialogue and text steering, with Gemini 3.8 Flash planning events inside the simulation loop.

The post Meet Google DeepMind’s Genie 4: Real-Time World Model With Native Audio appeared first on MarkTechPost.

item.title: Meet LEANN: An Open-Source Vector Index that Shrinks a 60M-Chunk RAG Index from 201 GB to 6 GB
item.description:
UC Berkeley’s LEANN vector index stores a pruned graph and recomputes embeddings at query time. It matches HNSW accuracy at 90% recall using 4 GB instead of 188 GB, at the cost of seconds-level search.

The post Meet LEANN: An Open-Source Vector Index that Shrinks a 60M-Chunk RAG Index from 201 GB to 6 GB appeared first on MarkTechPost.

item.title: Liquid AI Releases LFM3: 6 Open-Weight 2B-Class Multimodal Models
item.description:
Liquid AI released LFM3, 6 open-weight 2B-class models for text, vision, audio, omni and decisions. LFM3-1.7B uses a tri-hybrid backbone, a 256K context window and fits in about 1 GB at 4-bit.

The post Liquid AI Releases LFM3: 6 Open-Weight 2B-Class Multimodal Models appeared first on MarkTechPost.
